Counting Betweenness

Source: R/centrality-batch56.R
centrality_counting_betweenness.Rd

Counting betweenness (Bloechl et al. 2011) is the expected number of times a random walk passes a node on its way between two other nodes, averaged over all ordered pairs. A walker at \(i\) follows the tie to \(j\) with probability \(m_{ij} = a_{ij} / \sum_k a_{ik}\). For a walk from \(s\) that stops when it first reaches \(t\), the expected number of uses of the tie \((i, j)\) is \(N^{st}_{ij} = m_{ij}\,[(I - M_{-t})^{-1}]_{si}\), and $$C_c(i) = \frac{1}{n(n-1)} \sum_{s} \sum_{t \ne s} N^{st}(i), \qquad N^{st}(i) = \sum_{j \ne t} \frac{N^{st}_{ij} + N^{st}_{ji}}{2},$$ with one added for the start \(s\), and \(N^{st}(t) = 1\).

Usage

centrality_counting_betweenness(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality, such as weighted and normalized.

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order, or NA at every node when the score is undefined.

Details

Direction, weights and loops are used. A walk that goes back and forth over a tie is counted every time, which sets the measure apart from random walk betweenness that counts net flow. A loop makes the walker stay, and raises the score of its node. The scores are expected numbers of visits and are not bounded by 1.

Following the source, a node without incoming or without outgoing ties scores 0 and is left out of the walk. The remaining nodes must be strongly connected. Otherwise every score is NA with a cograph_undefined_measure warning. The measure inverts one matrix per node, so it is costly and is computed only when requested by name or through include.

References

Bloechl, F., Theis, F. J., Vega-Redondo, F. and Fisher, E. O'N. (2011). Vertex centralities in input-output networks reveal the structure of modern economies. Physical Review E, 83(4), 046127. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.83.046127 .

See also

centrality_random_walk, centrality_mec, centrality.

Examples

centrality_counting_betweenness(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>  1.7872438  0.4572682  2.7767743  1.8243107  1.7936309  0.9713849  0.5105718 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>  1.0941240  2.1476285  1.4107039
